section_summary.extract_value: This section details the participants for a single study, drawing data from the STAGE twin cohort and a web survey conducted between 2012 and 2013. A sample of 9537 individuals, with a mean age of 41 years, was extracted from 10,539 twins who participated in the survey. The text notes that the sample size varied between measures due to participant dropouts.
